arxiv-2107-11296.title: Effect of the density of pillar-patterned substrates on the contact mechanics: Transition from top to mixed contact with a detailed pressure-field description
arxiv-2107-11296.creator: René Ledesma-Alonso, Elie Raphael, Frédéric Restagno, Christophe Poulard
arxiv-2107-11296.description: Abstract Different contact regimes between a spherical lens and a periodically patterned substrate are observed, when they are pressed against each other. Top contact occurs when only the highest substrate sections touch the lens, whereas mixed contact implies that both the highest and the lowest substrate sections come into contact with the lens.

arxiv-2410-05425.title: Designing a Classifier for Active Fire Detection from Multispectral Satellite Imagery Using Neural Architecture Search
arxiv-2410-05425.creator: Amber Cassimon, Phil Reiter, Siegfried Mercelis, Kevin Mets
arxiv-2410-05425.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Amber Cassimon, Phil Reiter, Siegfried Mercelis, Kevin Mets. This paper showcases the use of a reinforcement learning-based NAS ( NAS ) agent to design a small neural network to perform active fire detection on multispectral satellite imagery.

arxiv-2502-15132.title: CoT-ICL Lab : A Synthetic Framework for Studying Chain-of-Thought Learning from In-Context Demonstrations
arxiv-2502-15132.creator: Vignesh Kothapalli, Hamed Firooz, Maziar Sanjabi
arxiv-2502-15132.description: Abstract We introduce CoT-ICL Lab , a framework and methodology to generate synthetic tokenized datasets and systematically study chain-of-thought (CoT) in-context learning (ICL) in language models. CoT-ICL Lab allows fine grained control over the complexity of in-context examples by decoupling (1) the causal structure involved in chain token generation from (2) the underlying token processing functions.

arxiv-2507-14422.title: Multipartite entanglement from ditstrings for 1+1D systems
arxiv-2507-14422.creator: Zane Ozzello, Yannick Meurice
arxiv-2507-14422.description: Abstract We show that multipartite entanglement can be used as an efficient way of identifying the critical points of 1+1D systems. We demonstrate this with the quantum Ising model, lattice λ ​ ϕ 4 \lambda\phi^{4} approximated with qutrits, and arrays of Rydberg atoms.

arxiv-2508-08279.title: XFMNet: Decoding Cross-Site and Nonstationary Water Patterns via Stepwise Multimodal Fusion for Long-Term Water Quality Forecasting
arxiv-2508-08279.creator: Ziqi Wang, Hailiang Zhao, Cheng Bao, Wenzhuo Qian, Yuhao Yang
arxiv-2508-08279.description: Abstract Long-term time-series forecasting is critical for environmental monitoring, yet water quality prediction remains challenging due to complex periodicity, nonstationarity, and abrupt fluctuations induced by ecological factors. These challenges are further amplified in multi-site scenarios that require simultaneous modeling of temporal and spatial dynamics.

pmc-10649998.title: Medical Rehabilitation of Patients with Post-COVID-19 Syndrome—A Comparison of Aerobic Interval and Continuous Training
pmc-10649998.creator: Johanna M. Mooren, René Garbsch, Hendrik Schäfer, Mona Kotewitsch, Melina Waranski, Marc Teschler, Boris Schmitz, Frank C. Mooren
pmc-10649998.description: Introduction: Post-COVID-19 syndrome (PCS) is a multisystemic disorder marked by impaired physical performance as one lead symptom. Since it has been suggested that endurance training as part of medical rehabilitation may be effective in improving physical performance capacity in PCS, this study aimed to compare different modes of aerobic endurance training. Methods: A total of 110 PCS patients (49.

pmc-11475796.title: Perioperative Pain Management in Hemophilic Patient Undergoing Orthopedic Surgery: A Narrative Review
pmc-11475796.creator: Antonio Abed Mahagna, Salvatore Annunziata, Camilla Torriani, Eugenio Jannelli, Benedetta Mascia, Alice Montagna, Mario Mosconi, Consalvo Mattia, Gianluigi Pasta
pmc-11475796.description: Background: Hemophilia type A and B is associated with spontaneous bleeding in muscle tissues and joints. Acute hemarthrosis, representing 70–80% of all bleedings in severe hemophilia patients, is extremely painful. When surgical procedures are needed in hemophiliac patients, perioperative management should be planned with a multidisciplinary team.

pmc-12566583.title: microRNA Biomarkers in Paediatric Infection Diagnostics—Bridging the Gap Between Evidence and Clinical Application: A Scoping Review
pmc-12566583.creator: Oenone Rodgers, Anna De Beer, Thomas Waterfield
pmc-12566583.description: Background: Distinguishing between bacterial and viral infections in children remains a significant challenge for clinicians. Traditional biomarkers have limited utility, often leading to antibiotic overprescription due to clinician uncertainty. With rising antimicrobial resistance, novel biomarkers are needed to improve diagnosis.

pmc-12587744.title: Characteristics of preoperative electrically evoked middle latency responses and postoperative cochlear implant effects in patients with tinnitus
pmc-12587744.creator: Bin Wang, Xiaohui Guo, Chaogang Wei, Wei Lv, Zhiqiang Gao, Suju Wang, Keli Cao
pmc-12587744.description: ObjectiveTo analyse the characteristics of electrically evoked middle latency responses (EMLR) in patients with profound sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) and tinnitus.MethodsThirty adults with profound SNHL and tinnitus who underwent cochlear implantation were selected as the tinnitus group, and 15 patients with profound SNHL but without tinnitus served as the control group. Preoperative data were retrospectively analysed.

pmc-12809936.title: Self-efficacy and family support in the relationship between stress and readiness for disaster response among nurses: a mediation analysis
pmc-12809936.creator: Peng-Ching Hsiao, Shu-Yen Lee, Chin Lin, Chou-Ping Chiou, Kai-Jo Chiang, Hsueh-Hsing Pan
pmc-12809936.description: BackgroundNurses’ readiness for disaster response is influenced by stress, self-efficacy, and family support. Understanding these mediating roles is crucial for enhancing readiness and ensuring effective patient care during disasters. This study examined whether self-efficacy and family support can mediate the relationship between stress and readiness for disaster response among nurses.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 476 registered nurses.

pmc-12843259.title: Ninjin’yoeito for Impaired Oral Function in Older Adults: A Prospective, Open-Label Pilot Study
pmc-12843259.creator: Quang Trung Ngo, Akiko Shirai, Hongyang Li, Akiyoshi Takami, Akihiro Kawahara, Lian Liang, Tomokazu Yoshizaki, Keiko Ogawa-Ochiai
pmc-12843259.description: Background and Objectives: Japan’s aging population faces growing challenges related to oral frailty, a condition characterized by the decline of oral function associated with physical and nutritional deterioration. Impaired oral function contributes to reduced chewing, swallowing, and saliva secretion, leading to poor appetite and frailty progression.

pmc-12853702.title: Association of weight-adjusted waist index with motoric cognitive risk syndrome in Chinese adults Aged ≥ 60 years
pmc-12853702.creator: Gui Qian, Beijia Liu, Zhengzheng Liu, Yue Wu, Ya Zhao, Xiaoli Tang
pmc-12853702.description: ObjectiveThe primary objective of this study is to assess the association between the Weight-Adjusted Waist Index (WWI) and Motoric Cognitive Risk (MCR) syndrome in the elderly Chinese population.MethodsA cross-sectional design was employed, drawing upon data from the 2015 wave of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS).

pmc-13358343.title: The impact of Métis Nation of Ontario citizens’ housing satisfaction on self-reported health: a population-based retrospective cross-sectional study
pmc-13358343.creator: Tatiana Baziw, Carolyn Lacka, Robynn Sadler, Abigail J Simms, Noel Tsui, Amy Mersereau, Cindi Rye, David Crenna, Jeff Evenson, Sarah A Edwards
pmc-13358343.description: IntroductionDistinction-based research on the relationship between housing and health for Métis people is limited, despite a recognised housing crisis for Indigenous Peoples in Canada. This study examines the association between housing conditions and repairs with self-rated physical, mental, and overall balance of health in citizens of the Métis Nation of Ontario (MNO).

pmc-13639169.title: Systematic image perturbations reveal persistent gaps between human and machine vision
pmc-13639169.creator: Mugihiko Kato, Biyu J. He
pmc-13639169.description: SummaryDeep neural networks (DNNs) are promising computational models for understanding visual object recognition. Yet, whether DNNs use similar visual cues for object recognition as humans do remains unknown. We created an image set that systematically untangles global shape, internal parts, and texture information, and compared human recognition behavior against >200 DNNs spanning diverse architectures, training diets, and training objectives.

uslaw-usc-t28-s103.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part I (Organization Of Courts); Chapter 5 (District Courts). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Minnesota constitutes one judicial district comprising six divisions. (1) The First Division comprises the counties of Dodge, Fillmore, Houston, Mower, Olmsted, Steele, Wabasha, and Winona. Court for the First Division shall be held at Winona. (2) The Second Division.
